samples.prompt: Once upon a time, a little girl found a tiny dragon in her garden.
samples.continuation:
She was very happy and did not know how to play with it.
The girl went to the garden and found some flowers and bugs in the garden. The girl felt happy and knew she had to play in the garden.
The girl decided to share the flower with the other animals. They played for a long time and found the flower. They all laughed and had a great time.
At the end of the day, the little girl gave the flower a big hug and a big smile on her face. She was so happy that she could play with the flower again. 
The moral of the story is that it's important to always be careful when they need something special.
